title: Option to additionally send weather alerts as notifications
line: The Weather Report widget now sends a notification when a new weather alert is issued for your location, with an option to turn it off.
explanation: Weather alerts (flood, wind, storm warnings from NOAA, DWD, Environment Canada) were only listed on the widget's Notices page, so you only saw them if you happened to open the popup. Nothing in the widget sent notifications. The widget now sends one notification per new alert (headline only, high urgency for severe alerts, a Show details button that opens the widget) and remembers which alerts it already announced, so restarts and forecast refreshes don't repeat them. A new "Weather alerts: Show as notifications" checkbox on the Weather Station page turns it off.

commits.message:
applets/weather: show weather alerts as notifications

Weather alerts were only visible inside the widget's popup, so nobody saw
them unless they happened to open it. Each new alert is now also sent as
a notification once, with an option to turn this off in the settings.

BUG: 517029

media.caption: Master: Yuma, AZ has two active flood warnings, visible only on the widget's Notices page
Master: the popup just says "2 Notices"; no notification is ever sent
Fix: each alert pops up as a notification after login
Fix: alerts stay in notification history with a Show details button that opens the widget
Fix: new "Weather alerts: Show as notifications" checkbox in the Weather Station settings

review.text: Sending notifications for new alerts through a proper notifyrc, with an opt-out and dedup kept in config, is the right shape. However, the QML gets the headline by regex-parsing the HTML the ions put in the description, which works around a missing field in the weather data library in the same repo. The dedup key also includes the timestamp, so a provider that re-issues or updates an alert will notify again.
changes: Expose a headline/title for each warning from the ions through the weatherdata Warnings model (a new role in applets/weather/weatherdata/warnings.h), and use it instead of parsing HTML in main.qml.
Key remembered alerts on a stable identifier (or on headline + description without the update timestamp) so updated alerts aren't announced again.
